name: Plakar
description:
Plakar is a modern data protection solution focused on what remains the most critical line of defense for businesses: backups.
At the core of Plakar is a new data engine called Kloset, a purpose-built technology designed to rethink how data is captured, stored, and recovered. Kloset makes data inherently easy to deduplicate, replicate, and distribute across multiple storage targets, with an architecture that is Exabyte-ready by design. It is also built to meet the highest security standards, ensuring integrity and confidentiality across the entire data lifecycle.

Plakar is built for environments with strict constraints, including highly regulated industries and long-term data retention needs, where reliability, resilience, and cost control are critical. At the same time, it remains simple and efficient for everyday operations. It significantly reduces cloud or infrastructure costs, defends against ransomware, and enables rapid recovery. Its efficient deduplication allows organizations to retain more backups over longer periods at very low cost, while reducing recovery time objectives.

Plakar supports a wide range of storage backends such as local disks, S3-compatible services, and even tape. It integrates naturally into modern infrastructure thanks to its open source foundation and DevOps-friendly design.

We believe data protection should be effortless, secure, and economically sustainable. Plakar sets a new standard for long-term, high-integrity data resilience.

name: OCamlPro
description:
OCamlPro harnesses state-of-the-art languages like #OCaml and #Rust to help design & implement safe & powerful software #Formal Methods

OCamlPro is a French software company born in 2011 and located in Paris, Lyon, Rennes and Toulouse. We are dedicated to improving the quality of software, through the use of formal methods. For that purpose, OCamlPro promotes the use of state-of-the-art programming languages like OCaml and Rust, matured for decades in Public Research labs in the world. 
We harness our Programming Languages expertise to help audit and optimize (or migrate) core infrastructures. 
And we develop safety-oriented verification and testing tools, such as the Alt-Ergo theorem prover, the OWI (OCaml Wasm Interpreter) Toolchain, the Autocouv Seacoral automated testing framework. 
Our mains focus are:

* Prototyping (OCaml / Rust), Dev tooling and Language audit and design (DSLs, COBOL migration): we help optimize critical infrastructure core pieces and we design ad hoc specific languages (DSLs) for business lines like cinema revenues share computation or tax calculation, or combinatorial optimization in logistics. We also offer open source tools to developers. And we provide business-level and long-term support to the OCaml language to make it more suitable for use in a wider range of professional environments.

* Formal methods: OCamlPro is involved in collaborative projects with academic and industrial partners to develop tools for software verification, such as the Alt-Ergo SMT Solver (from LRI), the Autocouv Project for automated testing, OWI a post-JavaScript OCaml Wasm Interpreter toolchain.

* Blockchain (now essentially training): from 2014, design and development of the Tezos prototype and ICO on Bitcoin and Ethereum, as well as several related projects - a block explorer and a higher-level programming language for smart contracts, with initial tooling for formal verification using the Why3 (INRIA) and Alt-Ergo tools.

name: Infinit
description:
Infinit's next generation storage platform is scalable and resilient while being highly customizable for container environments:
- Software-based: can be deployed on any hardware from legacy appliances to commodity bare metal, virtual machines or even containers.
- Programmatic: developers can easily automate the creation and deployment of multiple storage infrastructure, each tailored to the overlying application's needs through policy-based capabilities.
- Scalable: by relying on a decentralized architecture (i.e peer-to-peer), Infinit does away with the master/slave model, hence does not suffer from bottlenecks and single points of failure.
- Self Healing: Infinit's rebalancing mechanism allows for the system to adapt to various types of failures, including Byzantine.
- Multi-Purpose: the Infinit platform provides interfaces for block, object and file storage: NFS, SMB, AWS S3, OpenStack Swift, iSCSI, FUSE etc.

name: YAMA
description:
At Yama, we develop a new class of carbon capture for low-concentration CO₂ streams across power and industrial assets - one of the largest and least solved segments of the market.
 
Our electrified platform combines a non-toxic sorbent with advanced membranes to break the cost and operational limits of conventional systems. De-risked through DAC pilots in harsh air conditions, we now deploy it on dilute, variable point-source streams.
 
We focus on gas turbines, CCGT, and intermittent industrial processes, where amines struggle—cutting capture costs by up to 50% with a modular, flexible and plug-and-play system requiring no process changes.
 
We are scaling across gas-fired infrastructure and data centers to decarbonize existing assets.
 
Working with:
- Utilities, hyperscalers & industrial operators
- OEMs, EPCs & project developers
- Buyers of carbon credits & e-fuels

Fondée par deux anciens formateurs, Steven Berg et Florent L'Hélias, Jylia part toujours du métier avant de parler technique. Notre conviction : relier les outils, simplifier le quotidien, transmettre l'autonomie.

Basés à Bordeaux et à Paris, nous intervenons partout en France, sur site comme à distance.

name: SurgeCare
description:
Our immune system holds a wealth of information about our health. However, medicine still uses only a fraction of it. 

Born out of work begun at Stanford University, Surge is a French startup built on ten years of research at the interface of immunology and artificial intelligence. 
Our technologies decrypt each patient's immune profile with unprecedented precision. We then turn these results into essential decision-support tools for clinicians. 

What does that look like in practice? 
Our first product, PreCyte, is a simple blood test that runs on standard hospital lab equipment. A day after surgery, it can already flag if a patient is at risk of infection. This is four days sooner than today's tests. In consequence, clinicians have extra valuable time to adapt care to each patient's needs.

Notre système immunitaire recèle une mine d'informations sur notre santé, que la médecine n'exploite encore que trop partiellement.

Née de travaux engagés à l'Université de Stanford (États-Unis), Surge est une start-up française qui s'appuie sur dix ans de recherche à l'interface entre l'immunologie et l'intelligence artificielle. Nos technologies décryptent le profil immunitaire de chaque patient avec une précision inédite. Nous traduisons ensuite ces résultats en outils d’aide à la décision, pour permettre aux médecins de proposer à leurs patients des parcours de soins parfaitement calibrés à leur situation.

Et concrètement ? 

Notre premier produit, PreCyte, est un simple test sanguin, qui utilise des équipements présents au sein du laboratoire de l’hôpital et permet d’identifier les patients à risque d’infection dès le lendemain d’une opération chirurgicale, soit quatre jours avant les tests existants. Les médecins gagnent ainsi un temps précieux pour adapter plus tôt les soins aux besoins de chaque patient.

name: Ganymed Robotics
description:
There are more and more humans. More and more of them need surgery. Orthopedics especially is driven primarily by age and weight so... yeah. It's going to be impossible to train as many surgeons, let alone good and experienced ones, as the world needs. So what do we do? Let people die of a fractured hip? 

We believe technology holds part of the answer. We believe the success or failure of a surgical intervention shouldn't be a direct result of the surgeon's state of mind. We believe it's possible to create tools that will improve both patient outcome and surgeon experience. We believe it's unacceptable to live in a world where *5 billion* people have no access to surgery whatsoever. 

We develop advanced robotics technologies for orthopedic surgeons. So that more people have access to life-changing orthopedic surgeries, safely and affordably. Freedom starts with movement. And we believe in what we do.

Supported by A-Level entrepreneurs and innovators such as Bruno Maisonnier (Founder of Aldebaran Robotics, Founder & CEO AnotherBrain) and world-class orthopedic surgeons, we work hard to change the status quo in surgery. 

We are incubated at one of Europe's best life science incubator, Paris Biotech Santé (ever heard of DNAScript, Therapenacea and Therapixel ? They are here too). We have raised significant seed money. We have gathered a world-class team. We're all in. We're still hiring.

name: MEDADOM
description:
MEDADOM est une startup e-santé en très forte croissance et première société de téléconsultation à être agréée par le Ministère de la Santé.

Notre objectif principal consiste à rendre l'accès à un médecin généraliste plus simple en proposant une solution complète de téléconsultation via une application web/mobile ainsi que des bornes connectées. Nous nous engageons à offrir une mise en relation avec un médecin généraliste sans nécessité de prendre un rendez-vous préalable, et notre plateforme est accessible 7 jours sur 7 pour plus de flexibilité.

Fondée en 2017 par deux médecins (Elie-Dan et Charles MIMOUNI) et un ingénieur polytechnicien (Nathaniel BERN), nous disposons d’une double expertise dans le domaine de la Santé et de la Tech.

MEDADOM est né d'un même désir celui de lutter contre les inégalités d’accès aux soins sur le territoire français : multiplication des déserts médicaux, engorgement des urgences, renoncement aux soins, absence du médecin traitant, médecin traitant indisponible.

The most develop AI that regulate and do the triage at emergency services at the hospital.
With the best features like medical protocol, interoperability and the triage AI, we can provide the best care for patients.
The right care at the right place on the right time.

The saturation of emergency services and the difficulty of accessing care are the reasons for the existence of H24CARE. We redirect non-priority or relatively urgent patients to appointments in town.

For this, our innovative medical teams have developed a software suite consisting of 3 solutions:

H24Emergencies: an AI that allows patients to be sorted and redirected to the city safely and with a confirmed appointment.
H24SAMU: an AI that assists in the regulation and care of patients contacting SAMU 15.
H24Lib: a medical protocol intended for community medicine, allowing better care of patients sent by emergencies or Samu.

Access to health in the context of unscheduled care must be easier, more fluid, and adapted. Removing emergency congestion is our mission, offering alternatives is our solution!

The observation of medical desertification and an aging population with multiple chronic illnesses and various pathologies can present a pessimistic observation: yet solutions exist.

Our voluntary and responsible approach is to offer a solution that can relieve emergency nursing staff and improve patient care! Through interprofessional collaboration and coordination, we will be able to build a new health system.

name: Medjeduse - Spinal Cord Regeneration Research
description:
Medjeduse is a groundbreaking startup emerging from cutting-edge research at CNRS’s "Axonal Regeneration and Growth" team, focused on spinal cord repair. Unlike exoskeletons and brain interfaces that address symptoms without solving the root cause, we tackle spinal cord injuries directly. Our approach aims to provide a true solution for recovery rather than working around the problem.

The need for effective spinal cord injury treatment is immense, with injuries leading to emergency hospitalizations, deaths, and chronic disabilities (paraplegia, tetraplegia), across all ages. Currently, there are no therapeutic solutions beyond long-term physical rehabilitation. Each year, 30,000 new cases arise in the USA and Europe, with a global lifetime cost of €70 billion.

Our solution is a bioscaffold that promotes spinal cord repair through our pioneering biomaterial. It has shown remarkable success in preclinical trials, enabling rats to regain the ability to walk and demonstrating unprecedented nerve regeneration and mobility recovery.

 Medjeduse is committed to transforming this innovation into a practical therapy to enhance recovery and quality of life for patients.

description:
ZebraMed is a Paris-based TechBio company automating the ethical generation of living organisms’ data via a proprietary robotics platform, zebrafish embryo models, and human data to generate digital Systemic Human Profiles to enable predictive AI-driven drug discovery. 

The pharmaceutical industry pours billions into AI, yet 90% of therapeutic candidates fail because current models are built on flat, single-target in vitro data. Cells simply cannot capture human systemic complexity. 

ZebraMed aims to discover new therapies for untreatable systemic profiles, taking into account human complexity and variability. ZebraMed is the only solution extracting data closest to humans, and we are the first to train a transparent AI architecture that predicts targets and explains the biology and decision-making process. By addressing the lack of insight into human systemic response with highly translatable, large-scale data, 

ZebraMed discovers new therapeutic assets and empowers pharmaceutical partners to reduce preclinical timelines by 50% and increase success and rescue rates in pharmaceutical pipelines.

The objective of [RE]MEDs is to contribute to the discovery of new medicinal applications to meet significant unmet medical needs, leveraging the most sophisticated data science technology.

To achieve this, we have developed an AI-powered methodology and corresponding technology for in-silico studies of medicinal effects, utilizing extensive electronic databases of medical, hospital, and administrative health records. Our current focus is on autoimmune disorders.

description:
Damae Medical is reinventing skin imaging, revolutionizing the screening, management, and follow-up of skin cancers (melanoma and carcinoma) with its deepLive™ solution, which provides an accurate, fast and reliable optical examination without performing a biopsy.
 
CE marked, the deepLive™ medical device is based on LC-OCT (Line-field Confocal Optical Coherence Tomography) proprietary optical imaging technology that provides 3D images of the different layers of the skin at the cellular level, complemented by several software and Artificial Intelligence (AI) modules. 
 
This innovation is protected by 6 patent families and has already been published in more than 100 scientific and medical publications.
 
Present in 10 countries and used in more than 50 referral centers, deepLive™ transforms the daily practice of dermatologists making the management of skin pathologies efficient, reassuring, and non-invasive for the patient. The product is also used by leading cosmetic and pharmaceutical players for research and evaluation purposes. 
 
Based in Paris, Damae Medical currently employs 30 people. Winner of several innovation awards (MIT Technology Review, Bpifrance, European Commission), the company has been able to invest more than €20 million since its creation in 2014.
 
For more information, please contact us by email: info@damae-medical.com

description:
Hopia est la solution de planification automatisée capable d'intégrer toutes les règles - collectives, légales et individuelles - pour proposer un planning équitable et optimal en un clin d'oeil.

Notre mission ? Libérer du temps aux soignants et médecins pour leur permettre de se concentrer sur leur métier : soigner et sauver des vies.

La première solution développée par HOPIA se concentre sur la planification des ressources humaines. Elle centralise toute la création et la gestion des plannings des médecins et des soignants. Elle s’appuie sur des algorithmes – dépassant l’état de l’art développés exclusivement par HOPIA - d’optimisation sous contraintes pour proposer l’organisation la plus optimale pour toutes les parties prenantes. Elle est capable d’adresser toute typologie d’établissements, de services (blocs opératoires, urgences, imagerie, services conventionnels etc.) ou d’utilisateurs (PM ou PNM). 
 
HOPIA propose une gestion intégrée de la planification des ressources hospitalières : gestion des desiderata, des plannings d’activité, des aléas (absences, échanges, reprises), gestion stratégique des équipes et proposera prochainement plusieurs modules de gestion du matériel.
 
Nous proposons une application web et mobile, qui sera continuellement enrichie avec toujours le même objectif : simplifier le quotidien de nos utilisateurs.

name: Présage
description:
L’ensemble de la planète connait un vieillissement de la population humaine. L’avance en âge est caractérisée par plusieurs phénomènes dont la fréquence et le retentissement croissent avec l’âge : fréquence des maladies chroniques, concomitance de ces maladies chez les mêmes individus (polypathologie), dépendance fonctionnelle et besoin d’aide dans les actes de la vie quotidienne, recours à l’hospitalisation et au placement en institution gériatrique. 

Nous sommes convaincus que la médecine personnalisée, prédictive grâce à l'intelligence artificielle, va améliorer durablement la situation des personnes âgées à domicile ou en établissement. 

PRESAGE développe le 1er dispositif médical qui prédit à 7 jours le risque d’hospitalisation en urgence d’une personne âgée vivant à domicile. 

Issue de 4 années de recherche clinique impliquant l’Agence nationale de la performance en santé (ANAP), 2 ARS, l’AP-HP et la CNAV, ce dispositif à destination des professionnels de santé, est le premier dispositif médical basé sur l’intelligence artificielle pour anticiper les hospitalisations en urgence.
 
PRESAGE est composé d’une dizaine de salariés et d’un conseil scientifique regroupant professeurs de médecine, experts en e-santé et chercheurs en data science. 

Ses clients sont d’une part des tutelles (ARS, CD) et des collectivités territoriales qui désirent améliorer le suivi à domicile de patients à risque d’un territoire et d’autre part, des structures d’aide à domicile (Résidence autonomie, SAD...) qui utilisent PRESAGE pour améliorer le maintien de l’autonomie des personnes et éviter des passages aux urgences.

name: Cyllene Therapeutics
description: Cyllene Therapeutics is the global leader in non-replicating HSV-1 (nrHSV-1) vector technology in neurology. Cyllene Tx is currently executing a Phase 1/2 study in the US with its lead DNA medicine candidate, EG110A, in patients with neurogenic detrusor overactivity (neurogenic bladder)-related incontinence. This is the first human study with nrHSV vectors targeting sensory neuron-based diseases. EG110A is being developed to address multiple severe bladder diseases, including overactive bladder (OAB), and has the potential to be a major improvement over existing therapies, resulting in better care for patients and lower costs for healthcare systems. The company’s unique HERMES platform delivers pinpoint neurotherapeutics to treat prevalent diseases of the peripheral and central nervous system. Its vectors can achieve focal transduction and then selective expression of transgenes in targeted subsets of neurons. With demonstrated clinical safety and possible repeat dosing, the large payload capacity of nrHSV-1 vectors allows for versatile DNA delivery and smarter DNA medicine.

description:
Real-time portable functional ultrasound neuro-imaging

ICONEUS is introducing functional ultrasound neuro imaging: a breakthrough imaging modality for brain activity monitoring based on blood flow imaging with ultra-high sensitivity.

For preclinical research, the portability and high versatility of our technology enables the study of brain activity at unprecedented scales and in a large variety of subject states: awake, behaving, freely-moving, resting-state and asleep conditions.

Our technology can be easily combined with other complementary modalities such as eeg headstage or optogenetics which are inherently difficult to combine with fmri.

Iconeus also offers key applications such as functional connectivity assessment between brain structures (connectomics) or stroke 4D monitoring.

Building on years of preclinical expertise and research, we’re now investing and supporting exciting new clinical applications, using our Iconeus One CR functional ultrasound system dedicated to clinical research.

name: Olva Medical
description:
Olva Medical is a medtech company specializing in the field of cardiology.

Olva Medical develops a portable and reusable electrophysiology platform.

Electrophysiology interventions allow for the treatment of cardiac arrhythmias, a major public health issue. These arrhythmias lead to a decrease in quality of life and increased mortality: 20% of strokes are caused by atrial fibrillation, the most common arrhythmia.

With the aging global population, the number of cardiovascular patients is increasing significantly. At the same time, hospitals' financial and material resources are becoming increasingly constrained. Our solution, an electrophysiology platform that fits into a briefcase with reusable catheters, allows for more affordable and safer electrophysiology interventions.

Our innovation stems from research conducted at the IHU Liryc, the leading research center in electrophysiology in Europe.

name: OTR3
description:
OTR3® is a French biotech company that has developed a new class of therapeutic agents used for skin and corneal healing. The therapeutic approach, called "Matrix therapy" is based on RGTA® (ReGeneraTing Agents), engineered biodegradable sugar-based nano-polymers, mimicking heparan-sulfates. 

After an injury, RGTA® target the wound, replace the degradated heparan-sulfates, bind to the proteins and growth factors and protect the matrix proteins from degradation. They restore the scaffold organization and the micro-environment of the cells allowing the tissue to rebuild. 

OTR3 has placed on the market medical devices indicated for the treatment of hard to heal chronic cutaneous ulcers and corneal ulcers.

OTR3's Pipeline include innovative therapeutic products for ischemic stroke (Project awarded a H2020 SME Instrument grant), Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) and chronic ulcer for epidermolysis bullosa (Project awarded a PIA Leader Innov'Up grant).

name: MYRIADE
description:
The Videodrop, developed by Myriade, is an innovative instrument designed to provide the easiest and fastest way to measure nanoparticle size and concentration. This advanced system combines optical innovation from the Langevin Institute with high-performance software algorithms, leveraging Interferometric Light Microscopy (ILM) for precise, real-time analysis.

Key Applications:

Videodrop is an ideal tool for scientists across various critical fields:

Lentiviral Vector (LV) Development: Essential for gene and cell therapies, Videodrop aids in the quantification and characterization of LVs, optimizing bioproduction processes and quality control. It offers a quick, reliable alternative to traditional physical titer methods, reducing time and cost.

Extracellular Vesicle (EVs) Research and Production: Whether EVs are studied as biomarkers or therapeutic agents, Videodrop enables accurate quantification for both fundamental and translational research, as well as optimizing production and purification processes. Its high repeatability and ability to measure viscous samples make it invaluable for longitudinal studies and in-process controls.

Lipid Nanoparticle (LNP) Formulation: Crucial for mRNA vaccines and therapies, Videodrop helps assess LNP quality, enabling better control of the formulation process and standardization of cell-based assays by particle concentration.

With its ability to deliver reproducible results in under a minute from a single drop, Videodrop streamlines workflows, enhances process monitoring, and supports critical stability studies, making it an indispensable asset for nanoparticle research and development.

name: Tongue Lab
description:
Our tongue says a lot about our health. Lingual dysfunctions are a major cause of problems as diverse as chronic snoring, obstructive sleep apnea (OSA), mouth breathing, malocclusion (misalignment of the teeth), bruxism (teeth grinding and jaw clenching), temporomandibular joint dysfunction and atypical swallowing. 

Tongue Lab created the TRP (Tongue Right Positioner), a patented, oral medical device designed to reeducate the tongue and permanently restore its physiological functions, position and muscle tone. The TRP is worn on the upper teeth while we sleep for an average of six months only. By treating the lingual dysfunctions that cause sleep-breathing disorders and other health problems we live with day and night, the TRP is designed to do much more than alleviate symptoms. Focusing on the cause of these frequent health problems means striving to cure them. Lingual reeducation with the TRP is meant to do just that. 

Clinical trials using the TRP are underway or will be launched soon to determine the scientific impact of the TRP as a cure for chronic snoring, OSA and sleep bruxism. Tongue Lab is currently working with dentists, orthodontists, sleep specialists, orofacial myofunctional therapists, and other healthcare professionals in Europe, the United States and Japan to bring the benefits of the TRP to as many people as possible worldwide.

At Tongue Lab our mission is to encourage people of all ages to awaken to their full potential and shoot for the stars. Lingual reeducation with the TRP can play an important role by improving breathing and the quality of sleep. Smiling with greater confidence can make a big difference too!

name: AnotherWorld Bioscience
description:
At AnotherWorld Bioscience, we are developing a new way to make plastics, using engineered microalgae that turn CO₂ and light into polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHAs).

PHAs are a family of natural polyesters that biodegrade in soil, freshwater and marine environments, with properties close to those of conventional plastics such as PP and PE. Today they are produced by bacterial fermentation of sugars or oils, which ties their cost and footprint to agricultural feedstocks. We take a different route. Our photosynthetic microorganisms capture CO₂ directly and convert it into PHA, without any organic carbon source.

Our approach combines advanced synthetic biology, strain engineering and process design, with the ambition of making bioplastics competitive enough to replace fossil-based plastics at scale.

AnotherWorld Bioscience is a deeptech startup in creation, founded by synthetic biologists with deep expertise in microalgae genetic engineering, and incubated at the Biofonderie de l'Alliance Sorbonne Université in Paris.

name: Kimialys
description:
We are a team of chemists and biosensor engineers gathered around a common mission: shaping the future of biodetection for a better world.

Kimialys is the result of 10 years of meticulous academic research in surface chemistry. Controlling what is happening on the surface is a fundamental aspect of biosensing techniques such as rapid tests, point-of-care diagnostics, and real-time sensors. Without the right surface interactions, even the most advanced biosensors can falter, leading to misleading results. Our research efforts have always been to optimize these crucial parameters, ensuring both precision and reliable biodetection.

Founded in 2020, Kimialys is leading the charge in harnessing surface chemistry to revolutionize diagnostics and drug development, all supported by our patented K-One® technology. Building on this foundation, our coated gold nanoparticles elevate rapid diagnostic tests in terms of sensitivity, specificity and reproducibility. Additionally, our expertise in sensor chip functionalisation combined with our expertise in Surface Plasmon Resonance analysis empowers us to detect, screen, and select the most suitable biologics for both diagnostic and therapeutic applications.

Reliability, robustness, and adaptability are not just benefits of our technology; they are the cornerstones of the relationships we build.
For every customer we collaborate with, thousands of patients stand to benefit from our work.

name: EnnoDC
description:
EnnoDC is a clinical-stage biotech that designs and develops DC engagers.
By simultaneously allowing antigen-priming and controlled activation of dendritic cells in-vivo, these next generation immunotherapies induce a precise, broad and durable immune response in patients with the toughest cancer or viral infection.
Our proprietary DC engagers’ studio has fueled a dynamic pipeline of 5 antibody candidates. After a first clinical validation in HIV and COVID-19, the company is now advancing two programs in HPV16+ oropharyngeal and prostate cancer.

Founded in 2020, the company is located in PariSanté Campus (Paris, France) and Kendall Square (Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA).

The company's versatile platform, validated in infectious disease trials, is now advancing two programs in immuno-oncology:

• EDC.HPVE6E7 targets the Human Papilloma Virus HPV16 E6/E7 antigens in patients with HPV-16 induced oropharyngeal cancer, the most common form of this disease accounting for more than 60% of head-and-neck cancer cases.

This DC engager candidate is currently evaluated in a Phase I/II multicentric double-blind placebo-controlled dose escalation trial (NCT06007092). The study is conducted by Gustave Roussy, Europe’s first cancer center. In December 2024, EnnoDC has presented encouraging preliminary data at ESMO IO.

• EDC.PCA targets prostate cancer antigens. Prostate cancer is the second most frequent cancer in men, has the best survival rates (97% at 5 years) but the challenge of recurrence is still a major concern (up to 40% of patients). EDC.PCA is currently in preclinical development stage.

name: Cherry Biotech
description:
Cherry Biotech is a biomedical technology (Organ on Chip) company that develops instruments for drug discovery and personalised medicine. Its mission is to replace animal testing by reconstructing human tissue (Organoids) in vitro for drug testing. 

Cherry Biotech's CUBIX platform enables pharmaceutical, biotech companies and healthcare providers to recreate immunocompetent human vascularized organ models and tumor microenvironments for better evaluation of their drug candidates. 

By enabling the reconstruction of human 3D models that mimic human physiology and pathophysiology over several weeks, Cherry Biotech's proprietary CUBIX technology is the only solution that can convert a standard 2D multi-well plate into a 3D cell culture (Organ on Well). 

This innovative patented technology allows for the implementation of the current regulatory change on the ethics of animal experimentation while remaining compatible with the current industry workflow.

Cherry Biotech is among the innovative projects selected and supported by the Paris Saclay Cancer Cluster (PSCC), whose mission is to accelerate the development of innovation in oncology.

name: SynMetabio
description:
SynMetabio is building a new generation of biomaterials by turning biology into an engineered platform for material innovation.

We harness mycelium as a biological platform, combining controlled fermentation, biotechnology and nanobiotechnology to engineer new material possibilities. Our work spans the biological process - from strain selection and control to nano-scale engineering and material formation - enabling us to design structures, textures and performance characteristics for real-world applications.

From mycelium-based compounds to ready-to-use materials, we are bridging the gap between biological innovation and industrial manufacturing.

Today, our production capacity has reached more than 20 million linear meters, demonstrating our ability to take biomaterial innovation beyond the laboratory and into real-world production at scale.

Our vision goes further: to develop a new generation of materials where biology becomes an engineering platform, opening possibilities that conventional material production cannot.

Our technology platform also incorporates microalgae systems, exploring photosynthesis-based CO₂ capture and wastewater regeneration while creating opportunities to valorise biological resources throughout the production cycle.

Inspired by biology. Engineered for performance. Built for scale.

SynMetabio is redefining how the next generation of materials can be made.

name: Laboratoire RENASCOR
description:
Laboratoire RENASCOR is a French laboratory dedicated to advancing the science of hair regrowth and hair reconstruction after cancer.

Our work focuses particularly on a challenge that is often overlooked: hair reconstruction after cancer treatments.

Hair loss caused by oncology treatments - chemotherapy, radiotherapy or hormone therapy - is one of the most visible and emotionally difficult consequences for patients. Beyond the physical change, it deeply affects self-image and represents a delicate stage in the personal rebuilding process after illness.

Laboratoire RENASCOR develops specific approaches designed to support hair regrowth after cancer and to help patients rebuild their hair with confidence.

This expertise also leads us to explore the broader mechanisms of progressive hair loss and the many factors that influence the vitality of the hair follicle throughout life.

Today, our work is used by professionals involved in supportive oncology care as well as by specialists in hair and scalp health, including socio-aestheticians, socio-hairdressers, trichologists and healthcare professionals.

Laboratoire RENASCOR also participates in conferences, scientific congresses, training centers, hospitals and professional events in France and internationally to share knowledge and raise awareness about hair-related challenges in oncology.

Our belief is simple: hair reconstruction is an essential part of the recovery journey after illness, and understanding the mechanisms of hair regrowth is key to preserving long-term hair health.

name: Nanobiotix
description:
Incorporated in 2003, Nanobiotix is a leading, late clinical-stage nanotherapeutics company pioneering new approaches to significantly improve patient outcomes for millions around the world by building new therapies atom by atom.

The Nanobiotix philosophy is one rooted in designing pioneer physical-based approaches to bring highly effective and generalized solutions to address high unmet medical needs and challenges.

The Nanobiotix global development strategy seeks to address the largest market in oncology—patients who receive radiotherapy as part of their treatment—with NBTXR3 (JNJ-1900). As the first product candidate from the company’s nanoradioenhancer platform, NBTXR3 aims to increase the tumor-killing effect of radiotherapy without increasing damage to surrounding healthy tissues and synergize with other anti-cancer therapies such as immune checkpoint inhibitors.

Beyond NBTXR3, the Curadigm Nanoprimer Platform represents the second technology platform from Nanobiotix and the company’s next lever for growth. Curadigm's innovative approach seeks to improve treatment outcomes across several therapeutic classes by optimizing drug bioavailability and efficacy through systemic delivery enhancement.

Nanobiotix is listed on the regulated market of Euronext in Paris (Euronext: NANO / ISIN: FR0011341205; Bloomberg: NANO: FP) and on the Nasdaq Global Select Market (Nasdaq: NBTX). The Company’s headquarters are based in Paris, France, with a U.S. affiliate in Cambridge, MA. More: www.nanobiotix.com

Read our Social Media Community Guidelines: https://nanobiotix.com/social-community-guidelines/

name: ReaKt
description:
ReaKt is the on-premise software operating system designed to secure and accelerate the industrialization of precision fermentation bioprocesses. 

Today, manufacturers face three critical bottlenecks: slow and costly R&D recipe formulation due to a lack of predictive simulation tools, equipment failures or metabolic drifts caught hours too late by delayed offline assays, putting €50k–€100k of product at risk on a single run, and, above all, the challenging industrial scale-up hurdle where transferring a process from benchtop to commercial plant remains largely unpredictable. Our platform solves these challenges end-to-end: a low-data digital twin built in the lab enables rapid in-silico iteration and is directly transferred to the manufacturing plant to pre-empt and resolve scale-up bottlenecks, while soft sensors powered by hybrid models ingest all available process data to forecast faults, pinpoint optimal harvest windows, and safeguard every vessel in real time. 

Deployed entirely on-premise to preserve absolute sovereignty over proprietary strains and process data, ReaKt aims to become the universal industrial standard making precision fermentation predictable, reliable, and commercially viable.

name: nextProtein
description:
The world’s population is estimated to reach more than nine billion by 2050. Global food production will have to increase by 70 per cent to feed everyone. Meanwhile one third of all food produced is wasted.

At nextProtein we’re driven by a personal desire to address land and resource scarcity and feed a rising population sustainably. nextProtein can produce the equivalent amount of protein from 100sqm as 100ha of soya field.

Founded by couple Syrine Chaalala and Mohamed Gastli, we produce insect-based protein for animal feedstocks with a negligible carbon footprint, at a lower cost and with the equivalent nutritional value of traditional protein production. We do this by taking otherwise unconsumed food on which to raise the insects, returning protein to the food cycle.

nextProtein has years of experience in breeding Black Soldier Fly, which was selected specially for its beneficial, high-yield quality. Fly larvae are raised, harvested and then processed into valuable components of animal feed: an insect based protein for aquaculture, livestock and pets, an extracted fat and a natural fertilizer for use in agriculture.

Our process is EU-approved for aquaculture and pet food and is suitable for feedstocks for the poultry and pork industries.  

Based in France with production operations in Tunisia, nextProtein is also backed by a range of high-profile international investors and business angels who have recognised our potential to revolutionise the industry.

By combining menstrual blood, advanced molecular profiling, and computational modeling, endogene.bio generates high-resolution biological data at scale, unlocking a previously inaccessible layer of human biology.

Our work enables deeper understanding of disease mechanisms, patient stratification, biomarker discovery, and therapeutic development across uterine health.

We collaborate with pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, clinics, and research organizations to accelerate the next generation of diagnostics and therapeutics in women's health.

name: MedVir
description: MedVir for “Virtual Medicine” is an outstanding medical decision support expert solution. This unique artificial intelligence system based on Fuzzy Logic, is an intelligent medical system modeled on the reasoning of an emergency physician. Its role is to assess the patient’s condition by asking questions. Powered by over 30 years of research (field medicine and learned society), based on evidence-based medicine, this artificial intelligence system meets 3 needs: assess the seriousness of a condition, propose diagnostic hypotheses & guidance • MedVir Pre-Diag covers all symptoms, all speciality, all common & urgent diseases + 31 Rare diseases. Or assess the risks presented by a person linked to behavior, habits, work type, age & sex.. • MedVir Prev: assesses 45 risk factors and 60 pathologies. Finally inform the patient through a popularized encyclopedic database. • MedVir Wiki: 5,300 subjects (1350 illnesses), ie 70,000 pages of documents. In conclusion, MedVir provides: • A limited number of diagnostic hypotheses • The assessment of the seriousness of the situation (CCMU scale), • A Medical guidance (what to do, OTC drugs, explanations, etc. ) • An encyclopedic explanation for all the considered diagnoses. • An automatic anamnesis report, storable, printable, shareable, integrable. MedVir is both for patients, and for healthcare professionals (nurse, doctor, pharmacist, paramedic, etc.). MedVir is in SAS mode, easily interoperable, available on any medium (computer, smartphone, tablets, etc.). All the data are anonymous, unambiguously stored and searchable, for real time epidemiology. MedVir is in: French, English, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian. MedVir is a Class I Medical Device since 2017, designed & rigorously controlled by physicians with demonstrated reliability. Clinical study on real cases show that MedVir is 87% congruent with the final diagnosis given by the hospital after examinations. MEDVIR: universal help to care access and medical decision support.

Le Groupe AVEC, qui a pris ce nom en 2021, a été créé il y a vingt ans. Son activité principale se déploie dans les secteurs de la santé et de la prise en charge de la dépendance. Depuis dix ans, le Groupe a connu une forte croissance en sauvant, en moyenne, une activité par mois. 

Avec 10.000 collaborateurs, répartis dans toute la France, et 400 établissements, le Groupe AVEC se classe dans le top 10 des groupes français acteurs du soin aussi bien en ville qu’à l’hôpital, qu'à domicile et en maisons de retraite. Fort de ses 800 médecins, le Groupe AVEC déploie 80% de son activité dans les domaines associatifs et mutualistes, inscrivant l’entreprise dans le champ de l’économie sociale et solidaire. 

Non soumis au capitalisme boursier et assis sur un actionnariat familial, le Groupe se positionne comme le 1er acteur global de santé sur les territoires.

Son modèle vise à sauver des activités de santé ou de service à la personne menacées en mutualisant les moyens des structures qui rejoignent le Groupe et en maintenant les emplois locaux par la professionnalisation des collaborateurs.

Devenu entreprise à mission, le Groupe attache un soin spécifique à la bienveillance dans ses prises en charge et porte une attention toute particulière à la qualité de vie au travail. Il déploie une plateforme de e-santé innovante et est précurseur d'un nouveau modèle permettant l’accès aux soins et à la prévention pour le plus grand nombre.

Découvrez tous nos services et prenez rendez-vous sur avec.fr votre plateforme e-santé.

description:
Avec « Franchement ça va » découvre une méthode inédite qui mixe humour, science et technologie pour booster ton bien-être mental. Parce qu’un rire peut changer ta journée. Et parfois ton histoire.

Une app conçue par amour du rire
On prend la santé mentale au sérieux… mais pas trop quand même.
On est convaincus que l’humour est un excellent antidépresseur (sans ordonnance). Alors on a créé un endroit où tu peux venir rire, relâcher la pression, t’écouter un peu mieux, même quand tout va bien. Pas besoin d’aller mal pour venir.

Humour + Science = Résultat!
On ne rigole pas avec la santé mentale. Enfin… si justement. L’humour active des zones précises du cerveau, réduit le stress et libère les endorphines. C’est prouvé. Et maintenant, c’est dans notre application.

Ce qu’en dit la science 🧪
Des milliers d’études ont démontré ses effets positifs : sur le cerveau, le stress, la douleur, la mémoire, la confiance en soi, le lien social, l’apprentissage…

Franchement Ça Va, c’est une approche joyeuse, humaine et accessible de la santé mentale.

Pas de discours culpabilisant, ni de solutions miracles — juste une méthode sérieuse et légère, qui utilise l’humour comme porte d’entrée vers le mieux-être.

🎯 Objectif : te redonner le pouvoir d’agir, en parlant librement de tes émotions et en brisant les tabous.

🛠️ Comment ?
Avec des défis ludiques, un journal d’humeur, des contenus personnalisés et un accompagnement validé scientifiquement.

🧠 On ne remplace pas les traitements.
On les complète avec ce qu’il manque souvent : de la légèreté, de l’écoute… et du rire.

name: Detox
description:
Detox is an app for iPhone and iPad that helps you use your phone less.

You choose the apps to limit, and when Detox blocks them: after you've scrolled one for too long in a row, at set hours, once you've used up a daily time budget, or right away when you need to focus. Everything you don't pick, like messaging apps, maps or work apps, stays open.

Detox runs on Apple's Screen Time framework. You pick the apps in Apple's own list, so Detox never learns which apps they are and can't see what you do in them.

On the App Store since 2023, with 3,900+ ratings.

Peer-reviewed study with researchers from EPFL, HES-SO and Lausanne University Hospital: https://doi.org/10.2196/85349

name: StopTCA
description:
Imaginez Mylène, par exemple, qui, comme tant d’autres, vit avec un Trouble du Comportement Alimentaire (TCA) et se sent isolée. Au-delà de la douleur, elle fait face à un autre défi : trouver de l'aide. 
C'est là qu'intervient StopTCA, la première plateforme en ligne dédiée aux personnes souffrant de TCA et à leurs proches. 
StopTCA offre un accompagnement pluridisciplinaire et personnalisé, avec des professionnels spécifiquement formés aux troubles alimentaires. Grâce à des consultations en visio ou par téléphone et un suivi coordonné entre praticiens, StopTCA permet un accès rapide et complet aux soins, comblant ainsi les déserts médicaux et réduisant les délais d’attente. 

StopTCA : une approche innovante et unique qui repose sur 4 piliers : 
1. Une prise en charge pluridisciplinaire : Psychologues, diététiciens, et autres thérapeutes collaborent en temps réel autour de chaque patient, offrant un suivi global et coordonné.
2. Une expertise spécifique des TCA : Tous nos praticiens sont formés aux troubles alimentaires, pour un accompagnement adapté et ciblé.
3. Un accès facilité, même dans les déserts médicaux : Grâce aux consultations en ligne, nous réduisons les délais d'attente et permettons un accès rapide, même dans les régions peu desservies.
4. Soutien aux proches des patients :StopTCA accompagne également les proches, souvent laissés de côté, mais qui jouent un rôle crucial dans le processus de guérison.

name: Elsee.Care
description:
Chez Elsee, nous partons d’un constat simple mais alarmant : une grande partie des dépenses liées à la santé et au bien-être ne sont pas prises en charge par les systèmes de soins traditionnels, qu’il s’agisse de médecines douces, de compléments alimentaires, de sport thérapeutique ou encore de matériel spécifique comme les culottes menstruelles ou les outils de rééducation périnéale. 

Ces dépenses, bien qu’essentielles pour soulager des douleurs ou améliorer la qualité de vie, pèsent lourd sur le budget notamment celui des femmes.

Avec notre réseau de partenaires, nous pensons qu’il est temps de changer cela. 

Chaque femme mérite d’avoir accès à des solutions adaptées à ses besoins, sans que le coût soit un frein. 

C’est pourquoi Elsee propose :
	•	Un soutien financier inédit, avec des remboursements pour ces dépenses non couvertes par les assurances traditionnelles.

name: ankré
description:
80 % du temps de travail se passe assis. Et si on en faisait une opportunité de mouvement ?

ankré, c’est la solution du mouvement au travail.

Parce que la prévention santé n’est efficace que lorsqu’elle devient un réflexe collectif.

- La sédentarité n’est pas du sport : notre approche repose sur la régularité, pas la performance.

- Une solution pensée pour les RH, médecins du travail et responsables QVT : simple à déployer, mesurable et engageante.

et de la prévention une culture d’entreprise durable.

Pour les équipes RH, l’enjeu est devenu complexe : répondre à une diversité de besoins avec des ressources, des budgets et un temps limités.

✅ Des contenus et ressources pratiques accessibles en autonomie.

Un dashboard anonymisé permet de suivre les usages, identifier les besoins collectifs et mieux orienter les actions QVCT, dans le respect de la confidentialité de chacun.

L’objectif : plus de valeur pour les collaborateurs, moins de complexité pour les RH.

Soutenir le pouvoir d’achat, proposer des solutions adaptées aux besoins de chacun et construire une politique sociale plus lisible, accessible et utile.

Inaya is a personal, AI-powered hormonal assistant for women in perimenopause.

Most women go through perimenopause without a clear map: symptoms get dismissed, appointments are short, and the advice online contradicts itself.

Inaya helps women understand what’s happening in their bodies and what to do about it, with guidance on nutrition, movement and skin developed with a network of trusted medical and wellness experts.

Inaya was co-founded by a mother and her son, one who lived the problem and one who set out to build the solution with her.

Inaya launches soon, and we’re building it with women, not just for them. If you’re an investor, clinician, partner or early user, let’s talk.

name: My S Life
description:
My S Life accompagne la santé de toutes les femmes au travail.

HealthTech française, My S Life développe une plateforme de prévention qui aide les entreprises à intégrer durablement la santé des femmes dans leur politique RH grâce à la technologie, la formation et la donnée.

Les entreprises disposent d'une solution unique pour accompagner leurs collaboratrices, former leurs managers et piloter leur politique de prévention de la santé des femmes au travail.

Notre plateforme combine trois solutions complémentaires :

• My S Life App : une application de prévention qui accompagne les collaboratrices avec des parcours personnalisés, un suivi du calendrier menstruel et un journal des symptômes, plus de 400 contenus validés par des professionnels de santé et un accompagnement par des sages-femmes.

• My S Life Academy : une plateforme digitale de formation et de sensibilisation pour permettre aux managers, aux RH et aux équipes de mieux comprendre l'impact de la santé des femmes au travail et d'apprendre à repérer les signaux faibles.

• My S Life Analytics : des outils de pilotage permettant aux employeurs de suivre des indicateurs anonymisés et d'orienter leur politique de prévention dans la durée.

Notre ambition : qu'aucune femme n'ait à choisir entre sa santé et sa carrière.

name: SEPTIÈME
description:
Septième is an innovative, premium hair care brand founded in Paris in 2021 by Janina Boss Tåhlin and Malin Lindholm. Their aim was to reimagine hair care by stepping away from traditional routines and introducing a more effortless approach, simplifying beauty routines for busy women.

Septième is a company that blends and celebrates the best of two cultures: the clean aesthetics and minimalism of Scandinavian design, combined with the established French luxury and 'Je ne sais quoi' effortlessness of French women.

The idea behind Septième was born when one of our co-founders went to bed one night after doing her evening beauty routine and realised that she had used a number of products for her skin, including cleanser, serums and moisturiser, but not one single product for her hair.

“I would never go to bed without removing my makeup, so why would I go to bed without removing product residues and other impurities from my hair” 

Frustrated by the lack of a product that matched their vision, they decided to create their own. Collaborating with leading Swedish beauty experts, lab and scientists they pioneered an innovative product which provided them with the exact desired result. They created a revolutionary rinseless hair cleansing mist that takes effortless hair care into the future.

Septième is a hair care brand that believes that beauty looks best when it is effortless - and that effortlessness is an attitude and way of life.

name: CSP Paris Fashion Group
description:
Well, l’Indispensable marque spécialiste des dessous féminins : collants, bas, mi-bas et lingerie à l’allure sensuelle et actuelle.

Tout commence en 1927, avec la marque « Bas de France » associée à la société du même nom, héritant des productions de bas en soie. En 1970, le groupe Bugnon rachète la marque et la relance sous le nom « Well » sur le marché français. La société Textiles Well passe alors de 4 millions de paires produites en 1972 à 120 millions en 1990. L’innovation devient le cœur du développement de la marque. Well décide alors de diversifier son activité en élargissant son cœur de métier : en 1994, la marque se lance sur le marché de la lingerie féminine.

Depuis 2011, la société Textiles Well appartient au groupe CSP Paris Fashion Group.

Well met les femmes au cœur de l’innovation. La gamme Accord Parfait avec son innovation brevetée, offre un confort optimal, un collant aux fibres ultra-extensibles et au maillage spécialement conçu pour réduire la pression et épouser les courbes sans laisser de marque. Avec les produits de la gamme Contact, Well innove encore : les mi-bas, grâce à des microperles, adhèrent par contact à la peau, permettant ainsi de tenir sans serrer.

Sans oublier « la petite boite jaune », un concentré de technologie, de résistance et de beauté, Elastivoile Résistant, leader incontesté des collants en grande distribution. Il s’en vend un toutes les 2 minutes en France.

Well est distribuée dans les réseaux de grande distribution en France et en Belgique.

Well est fière de son ancrage français. Labellisée Origine France Garantie® depuis 2013, elle propose des produits fabriqués en France. Ce sont quelques 90% des paires de collants, de bas et de mi-bas qui sont tricotées dans l’usine Well. La marque revendique sa production française dans ses ateliers situés dans les Cévennes (au Vigan, dans le Gard). C’est un gage de qualité, d’éco-responsabilité, de mise en valeur des savoir-faire humains, de la valorisation de technologies innovantes et de garantie de l’emploi.

Marque à forte notoriété, Well est proche des femmes, à l’écoute constante de leurs attentes. Grâce au travail des coupes, des formes, des dentelles, des jeux de matières, et à une recherche et une créativité permanentes, les produits proposés par la marque sont innovants participant pleinement à l’intimité et au quotidien des femmes.

Well est accessible à toutes, proposant une solution efficace aux besoins de chacune. Chaque morphologie, chaque silhouette, chaque détail féminin est une source d’inspiration au quotidien, pour proposer des collants et de la lingerie dans l’air du temps. Prix accessibles, Confort absolu, Qualité irréprochable font de la marque un partenaire de confiance pour révéler la beauté unique de chacune.

Ces atouts la font se hisser comme 2ème marque sur le marché français des collants et mi-bas, et 7ème marque sur le marché de la lingerie.

name: Labstr
description:
Labstr is a qualitative research institute for health, beauty and nutrition brands. We design the study, run the fieldwork and defend the readout with your team.

WHERE WE WORK
Prescription pharma. Consumer health and OTC. Dermatological skincare. Food supplements and nutrition. Every claim in these categories is regulated, and every product carries a vigilance obligation. The method is built for that.

HOW WE WORK
1. Design. We turn your question into a protocol, with your team and our medical advisers.
2. Recruitment. Partner panels or direct sourcing, depending on how rare the profile is: physicians, pharmacists, patients, consumers.
3. Fieldwork. Each respondent talks to Labstr by voice, at a time that suits them. Interviews run in parallel instead of queueing behind a moderator's calendar, and analysis starts on the first transcript rather than the last.
4. Readout. Themes with verbatim support, an n on every claim, and a debrief with the researchers who ran the study.

WHAT WE COVER
- HCP and prescriber insights
- Patient and consumer experience
- Pricing and market access
- Claim, message and positioning testing
- Recall and message retention
- Longitudinal tracking

COMPLIANCE
Compliance is part of the design.

name: Karbonomics
description:
Karbonomics is building the economic system for demand-led decarbonization.

Regulation and corporate commitments have started the shift. On their own, they will not move it at the speed and scale that the climate targets need. Today, decarbonization still sits mostly on the cost side of business: something companies report, rarely something markets reward.

We believe the next phase will have to be driven with demand side pull and market dynamics. name: Kanop
description:
Nature-based projects are only as credible as the numbers behind them. Kanop is the MRV partner that makes those numbers rigorous, from feasibility to verification.

We work with project developers, investors, standards and corporate supply chain teams to answer the questions that decide a project's outcome: is this land eligible, what will it remove, what does the baseline look like, and what has actually been achieved year after year. Across ARR, agroforestry, REDD+, mangroves, improved forest management and supply chain removals.

Two things sit behind every answer. An infrastructure we built to run eligibility screening, dynamic baselines and monitoring at scale, with every step traceable for a validator. And a team of carbon scientists who apply it to each project's methodology, from ex-ante projections to PDD sections and monitoring reports.

The standards trust the approach. Kanop is a Verra-vetted Data Service Provider for VM0047 dynamic baselines, Isometric's Earth observation data partner for the Biosphere Protocols and Equitable Earth's official biomass data provider, and we work alongside Gold Standard, Cercarbono, Plan Vivo and BioCarbon Standard on the methodologies that make digital MRV work.

Underneath it all is our own data: aboveground biomass, carbon and land cover at 10m and 30m, anywhere in the world, annually since 2000. Built from optical, radar and LiDAR observations, calibrated with field and LiDAR data when a project has them, and always delivered with its uncertainty.

More than 70 organisations rely on Kanop today. From feasibility to verification, we forecast and quantify carbon and nature outcomes.

name: Glimpact
description: Glimpact is the first digital platform for assessing the overall environmental impact of products and organizations. The ecological transition depends on it: without measuring this impact, how can we know which actions are good for the environment? How can we help manufacturers to improve their products and also help citizens and consumers to make the most ecological choices? We all want to do something for the environment. But we often focus on just one aspect: carbon footprint, protection of the ozone layer, biodiversity... But the environmental impact of a product is much more than that. It also includes soil depletion, fine particles, consumption of water, fossil or mineral resources... In all, 16 different impact categories need to be taken into account throughout a product's life cycle. When it comes to environmental impact, the rule is simple: if you can't see everything, you can't see anything! The PEF (Product Environmental Footprint) method, developed by recognized experts, NGOs and manufacturers, provides a scientific, reliable and objective assessment of this impact. Adopted by the European Commission after 5 years of experimentation, it is the only method that assigns a global, universal and comparable score to a product. The Glimpact solution has modeled this method to make it accessible to all. With just a few clicks, you can accurately assess the full environmental impact of a product, factory or company. The result is a score, an "eco-score", comparable from one product to another, as well as an analysis of the main factors explaining this score, and the levers on which to act. Glimpact is a team of enthusiasts, bringing together top-level engineers, experts in environmental performance, and specialists in data processing and Big Data. With Glimpact, the ecological transition is finally possible!

name: Livelihoods
description:
Livelihoods is a global initiative that connects companies, local organizations and communities to turn climate ambition into tangible action. We are grounded in a core belief: there is no environmental impact without social justice.

Since 2009, we’ve mobilized private investment and field expertise to co-design and deliver long-term projects that restore natural ecosystems, improve livelihoods, and strengthen resilience.

With a team of 50 specialists and over 15 years of experience, we operate across two impact platforms: within value chains, we help companies transition to regenerative sourcing through the Livelihoods Fund for Family Farming and custom programs; beyond value chains, our three Livelihoods Carbon Funds drive nature-based solutions that restore degraded land, expand agroforestry, and improve energy access — generating high-quality carbon credits certified by international standards such as Gold Standard or Verra.

Our approach is non-speculative and outcome driven. Backed by 20 committed companies and led by Livelihoods Venture — a social business owned by our foundation — we’ve launched 47 large-scale projects, delivering 4.8 million tons of CO₂ reductions and removals, planting 159 million trees, and improving life for 2.4 million people in Africa, Asia, Europe and Latin America.

name: EnergieSprong FR
description:
Initiée aux Pays-Bas, l’approche Energiesprong est portée par un mouvement Européen d’acteurs qui veulent développer, dans un contexte de maîtrise de la dépense publique, un système de rénovations énergétiques des logements efficaces, désirables et viables économiquement, permettant d’offrir ainsi un bouclier énergétique aux occupants. L’ambition est d’engager un véritable changement d’échelle de la rénovation énergétique des logements, en introduisant de nouveaux standards sur le marché qui alignent les intérêts de tous l'écosystème.

Elle repose sur un cahier des charges exigeant : atteinte d'un niveau énergie zéro garanti tous usages sur 30 ans (le logement produit autant d'énergie qu'il en consomme) ; travaux en site occupé en une semaine ; surcoût financé par la revente d’énergie renouvelable et la réduction des dépenses énergétiques ; attention forte portée à la satisfaction des occupants (esthétisme, confort…).

Aux Pays-Bas, plus de 4000 logements rénovés selon les exigences Energiesprong ont déjà été livrés, et plus de 10000 le seront dans les prochaines années. Cette approche a fait ses preuves et a transformé des dépenses d’énergie en dépenses travaux, augmenté la qualité et baissé les coûts de ces rénovations, et dynamisé le marché de la rénovation énergétique.

La déclinaison d'Energiesprong en France a été lancée avec l'objectif de contractualiser 5 000 rénovations d’ici début 2019. A date, 2 premiers pilotes sont en cours de réalisation, et de futurs projets en cours de montage : 36 acteurs dont 9 bailleurs se sont collectivement engagés en 2017 à rénover 3600 logements. 

En France, le travail d’accompagnement du marché est porté par Ressorts avec l’Union Sociale de l’Habitat, le CSTB et le pôle Fibres-Energievie. Cet accompagnement est possible grâce au soutien financier de L’Union Européenne à travers les programmes Interreg North-West Europe à (projet E=0) et H2020 (projet Transition Zero), de l’ADEME et de la Caisse des Dépôts.

name: Énergies du Grand Paris
description:
Énergies du Grand Paris est la société d’économie mixte à opération unique (SEMOP) qui succèdera officiellement à la Compagnie Parisienne de Chauffage Urbain (CPCU) le 1er janvier 2027 pour exploiter le réseau de chaleur urbain grand parisien jusqu’en 2051.

Un passage de relais historique dans le cadre d'une mission de service public essentielle : fournir eau chaude et chauffage à plus d’un million d’habitants à l’échelle métropolitaine, puisque ce réseau alimente 17 communes dont Paris.

En décembre 2025, la Ville de Paris a choisi de confier la concession de son réseau de chaleur urbain à l’opérateur économique composé de Dalkia, Eiffage et RATP Solutions Ville, au terme d’une procédure d’appel d’offres lancée en 2023.
En avril 2026, elle a signé le nouveau contrat de concession avec la SEMOP associant la Ville de Paris (34 %), la Banque des Territoires (15 %) et l'opérateur économique (51 %) avec pour objectif d’accélérer la transformation du réseau de chaleur pour répondre aux enjeux de transition écologique et de souveraineté énergétiques

Ce réseau quasi centenaire, est aujourd’hui le plus grand réseau de chaleur urbain de France et l’un des plus importants réseaux vapeur d’Europe. Son infrastructure est composée de plus de 500 km de canalisations souterraines qui alimentent plus de 
6 000 bâtiments, soit l'équivalent de 450 000 équivalent-logements, dont :
• 100 % des hôpitaux publics parisiens,
• Près de 600 établissements scolaires et administratifs,
• 1 200 bâtiments publics au total.

Aujourd’hui ce réseau est encore composé à 50 % de gaz fossile. Demain, Énergies du Grand Paris ambitionne de remplacer le gaz par des énergies renouvelables et de récupération (EnR²) en augmentant leur part de 50 % à 76 % du mix énergétique.

En s’engageant sur cette trajectoire ambitieuse pour les 25 prochaines années, Énergies du Grand Paris réaffirme sa volonté de participer à la lutte contre le réchauffement climatique et la précarité énergétique.

name: Azard
description:
Azard is a climate risk intelligence platform built to help companies move from physical climate risk analysis to concrete adaptation decisions.

We combine climate projections, site-level operational data and transparent impact models to identify where climate risk is material, quantify what it may cost, and prioritise the actions that reduce risk most effectively.

With Azard, teams can:
• Screen portfolios of sites, assets and critical dependencies
• Rank priority hazards, vulnerabilities and business impacts
• Quantify damages, operating losses, cost increases and cost of inaction
• Simulate adaptation scenarios and compare gross vs. net risk
• Estimate the ROI of adaptation measures
• Build and monitor adaptation roadmaps across sites, functions and business units
• Consolidate data for climate reporting and long-term steering

Our platform is designed for climate adaptation teams, sustainability and ESG departments, risk management teams, operational leaders and consultancies working with asset-heavy or multi-site organisations.

Azard is built on three pillars: field reality, climate science and technology. We translate complex physical climate risks into business language: euros, downtime, avoided costs, residual risk, investment priorities and adaptation trajectories.

Because exposure maps and climate scores are not enough. Companies need to know where to act first, how much is at stake, which measures are worth funding, and how to coordinate adaptation over time.

From the site to the Group, Azard helps organisations build a common language to manage climate adaptation at scale.

Book a 30-minute working session with one of our climate risk experts: https://www.azard.io/en/contact/

Eligible products (electronics, appliances, fashion, sports, etc.) can be resold easily: consumers ship them back, receive a guaranteed payment, and our resale partners handle the rest.

For banks and financial institutions, Circulae offers a plug-and-play or fully integrated solution, enriching their card offerings, increasing engagement, and driving higher card usage. For consumers, it means trust, simplicity, and smarter financial management.

Beyond resale, Circulae opens the door to new services: product warranties, repair, insurance, and anonymized market insights for manufacturers and insurers. By transforming each payment into an opportunity for reuse, Circulae tackles the sourcing challenges of the second-hand market while reducing waste and building a sustainable ecosystem for the future.

Circulae: turning payments into a driver of sustainability, value, and trust.

IB2 is a French green tech company revolutionizing the aluminum industry. 

Aluminum is an essential metal in the ecological transition and the second most widely used metal in the world.

"Aluminium, a metal that can be recycled ad infinitum, is strategic for achieving low-carbon and waste recycling targets. IB2’s technical robustness combined with the agility of its model is helping alumina plants to produce by recycling bauxite waste."

name: NextWaste
description:
NextWaste: Independence at the service of a more efficient waste sector.

NextWaste is an independent French company with a clear mission: making waste management smarter, more transparent, and fully driven by data.

We develop and integrate cutting-edge technologies – AI, computer vision, automated characterization stations – to provide an exhaustive, objective, and actionable understanding of waste streams. Our entrepreneurial and field-driven approach allows us to support the entire value chain with agility: municipalities, waste syndicates, sorting centers, recyclers, industrial companies, and engineering firms.

What sets us apart?
We don’t just supply technology. We deliver independent, reliable, and reproducible analysis capabilities that are essential for objectively measuring performance, identifying deviations, securing facilities, and improving material recovery. Through continuous and automated characterization, our clients finally access complete industrial-grade data: real composition of waste streams, purity, contamination, material value, hazardous waste detection, operational anomalies, and more.

This level of transparency makes NextWaste a trusted third party capable of aligning public authorities, operators, and industrial players around a common and verifiable source of truth. Our ambition is clear: turning data into an environmental and economic performance lever to accelerate the circular economy.

In France and beyond, we are building a more efficient, more sustainable, and better-equipped industry—one that can finally understand what truly moves across its conveyor belts.

NextWaste: because you can only improve what you can measure.

name: Cinqo
description:
Cinqo est l’opérateur territorial des déchets industriels.
Du carton aux déchets dangereux, en passant par les ferrailles et métaux que nous rachetons, nous prenons en charge l’ensemble des flux de votre site avec nos partenaires locaux exclusifs.

1. Sur votre site : optimiser à la source
Caractérisation des matières, tri à la source, contenants adaptés, synoptique des flux et suivi du geste de tri : nous structurons la gestion de vos déchets au quotidien. Effet constaté sur votre budget : −20 % en moyenne la première année, jusqu’à −40 % lorsque la caractérisation initiale est insuffisante.

2. Sur votre territoire : cartographier les flux et mutualiser les collectes
Nos audits alimentent une plateforme de données qui cartographie les matières, les volumes et les besoins de collecte du territoire. Cette connaissance du gisement nous permet de mutualiser les collectes entre entreprises voisines : -30 % en moyenne constatés le coût du transport. En regroupant les volumes, nous ouvrons des filières inaccessibles à une entreprise seule et intégrons aux tournées existantes les flux trop petits pour être collectés seuls.

3. Conformité et RSE : des données fiables, des preuves concrètes
Cinqo tient votre registre déchets, vos attestations de tri et votre traçabilité. Vous disposez des tonnages, du taux de valorisation et du taux de diversion : la part détournée de l’enfouissement et de l’incinération. Ces données documentent votre amélioration continue pour ISO 14001 et EcoVadis, vos obligations de vigilance et vos réponses aux appels d’offres.

Votre audit de site est pris en charge par Cinqo, sans engagement. Prenez rendez-vous sur www.cinqo.fr.

name: Ecomaison
description:
Chez Ecomaison, nous croyons que toute matière a un potentiel. L’économie circulaire consiste à le révéler.

Éco-organisme opérationnel créé en 2011, Ecomaison est une entreprise privée à but non lucratif, agréée par les pouvoirs publics dont la mission est de prolonger la durée de vie des objets et des matériaux. Mobilier, literie, jouets, matériaux de construction, articles de bricolage et de jardin : nous organisons la collecte, le tri, le réemploi et le recyclage des objets et matériaux de la maison et des lieux de vie. Nous développons leur réemploi et leur réparation. Lorsqu’ils ne peuvent plus être utilisés, nous industrialisons leur recyclage.

L’objectif : produire des matières recyclées de qualité, capables de retrouver leur place dans les cycles de fabrication. Nous mettons en mouvement toute la chaîne de l’économie circulaire. Nous relions les entreprises, les collectivités, les acteurs de l’économie sociale et solidaire, les opérateurs du tri et du recyclage et les industriels.

Nous soutenons également l’innovation à toutes les étapes : écoconception, tri, démantèlement, préparation des matières, nouveaux procédés de recyclage, exutoires... Nous accompagnons le passage à l’échelle industrielle des solutions les plus prometteuses. L’enjeu est de produire des matières recyclées en quantité et en qualité suffisantes pour répondre aux exigences des fabricants.

Les filières des produits en bois, des produits rembourrés et des matelas en sont l’illustration. En développant les capacités de tri, les procédés de démantèlement et les débouchés industriels, nous contribuons à faire émerger des marchés de matières recyclées prêtes à entrer dans la fabrication de nouveaux produits.

En 2025, Ecomaison a collecté près de 2 millions de tonnes d’objets et matériaux, recyclées à 98% (réemploi, recyclage, valorisation énergétique). Avant notre création, 55 % des meubles usagés étaient enfouis.

description:
Recycler au bureau n’aura jamais été aussi simple !
Liez l’utile à l’agréable en optant pour une solution globale de recyclage de vos déchets du quotidien.

Aujourd’hui leader du recyclage en entreprise à Paris et en Ile-de-France, plus de 2000 clients nous ont déjà adopté permettant à plus de 130 000 salariés de recycler.

Le fonctionnement est très simple:

1 / Vous choisissez les déchets que vous souhaitez recycler :
Papiers, gobelets, canettes, bouteilles, capsules de café, cartouches d'imprimante, bouchons, piles, lampes, etc.

2 / Nous fournissons un service tout compris :
Installation de box de recyclage pour les déchets choisis, collecte par nos soins toutes les 2 semaines, garantie recyclage.

Présentation gratuite du service à vos collaborateurs, kit de communication pour véhiculer les bons messages auprès de vos parties prenantes, reporting mensuel affiché sur les box indiquant le poids collecté par déchet, programme de dons à l'association Ares Atelier pour chaque kilo collecté.

name: Cash Converters Europe
description:
Cash Converters change de dimension.

Fin 2024, l’enseigne a été rachetée par Pure Ventures, groupe industriel de l’économie circulaire. Notre objectif est clair : offrir la même expérience que le neuf, mais avec de l'occasion. 

Fini l’image poussiéreuse de la brocante. Place à des magasins transformés, inspirés des grandes enseignes du neuf : design, merchandising, expertise et conseil. Acheter de l’occasion chez nous, c’est désormais bénéficier du même niveau de confiance qu’ailleurs : 24 mois de garantie, financement, facilité de paiement, service client premium.

Nous avons resserré notre offre sur des univers passion : bijoux, gaming, high-tech, électroménager, luxe. Des catégories fortes où nos équipes et franchisés cultivent une expertise unique. Car c’est ça notre vision du retail : laisser au digital le self-service, et redonner en magasin ce qui a disparu ailleurs — la passion, le conseil, le lien humain.

Aujourd’hui, nous comptons déjà plus de 60 magasins en France. Mais l’aventure ne fait que commencer. Nous cherchons :
✨ Des franchisés entrepreneurs, avec la fibre business et l’envie de bâtir leur succès dans un retail en mutation.
✨ Des candidats passionnés, qui aiment le contact client, le service et veulent participer à la réinvention d’une enseigne historique.

La seconde main n’est pas une mode. C’est le futur du commerce.
Et chez Cash Converters, ce futur s’écrit maintenant.

🔥 Nous sommes en mouvement.
🚀 Nous sommes en croissance.
💡 Nous cherchons des talents et des partenaires prêts à vivre cette transformation avec nous.

name: Releaf Paper ®
description:
Releaf® is a materials engineering company converting fallen urban leaves into functional inputs for the paper and packaging industry. Our core innovation is the engineered deconstruction of heterogeneous leaf biomass into controllable fractions like fibers, fillers and blends that can be specified, tested and integrated into industrial paper grades.

We translate these fractions into commercial packaging substrates: roll paper and board for converters, and finished packaging products (bags, boxes and specialty formats). Our formulations are built as patented compositions designed for industrial runnability: drop-in adoption on standard converting lines, with defined performance windows and documented quality control.

Beyond paper and board, our R&D routes extend the same leaf-based fractions into molded and formed packaging solutions and tailored blends for specific packaging requirements.

Designed for recyclability in standard paper streams. Leaf-based substitution validated per grade and specification. Available grades include kraft and liner.

Energy becomes matter. Nature gives it structure. Releaf engineers its next form.

Entre 2 Rétros relève le défi de conjuguer mode, durabilité et design en transformant des matériaux industriels en sacs et accessoires.
Entre 2 Rétros est une marque au concept original et unique : la récupération et transformation de matériaux techniques et solides comme le tissu automobile, le cuir et les ceintures de sécurité en sacs et accessoires de mode.

En ne réutilisant que des matériaux existants, Entre 2 Rétros ne dépense ni ressource naturelle ni énergie supplémentaire et fabrique des produits durables et responsables.

Dans un style chic inspiré de l'automobile des années 50 et 60, Entre 2 Rétros élabore des sacs fonctionnels : housses ordinateurs et iPad, trousses de toilette, étui lunettes, mais aussi affaires d'un week-end, ou d'une journée en ville. Tous y trouvent leur place avec grâce.

La force et l'originalité de la marque sont le concept de « séries limitées », dès que les tissus sont épuisés, la gamme se renouvelle, ainsi que la qualité de ses produits.

Entre 2 Rétros distribue une collection en propre sur son site et via son réseau de détaillants, et propose également des produits personnalisés pour les entreprises pour une communication durable.
